confirmed.finding: 512 DPT uses separate self and world heads, pose is c2w from pose_encoding_to_camera; row-vector p @ R.T + t is correct. 224 LinearPts3dPose constructs world by transforming self and must not be pooled with DPT closure.
Compare self Z, not vector norm, to registered TUM PNG / 5000. Zero is missing; Freiburg 2 factor 1.031 has already been applied by dataset authors and must not be applied again.
source_sections: Intrinsic Camera Calibration of the Kinect

confirmed.finding: Full-sequence timestamp candidate enumeration and globally greedy one-to-one matching occur before selecting 300 RGBs; strict < .02 and tie order agree with stated local protocol. A brute-force enumeration check is planned but has not been executed by this reviewer.

512 preprocessing on 640x480 yields 512x384 without extra crop. Integer pixel-center nearest map preserves zero rather than interpolating missing depth. Agreement with PIL nearest is a proposed author preflight, not independently executed here.

Raw and pose_scaled metrics count nonpositive/nonfinite predictions as delta failures; full continuous metrics become NA and retain finite-prediction sums/counts. Strict delta threshold and equal-frame versus pixel-pooled distinction match protocol.

Per-frame median GT/pred scale is a retrospective diagnostic, not a guaranteed lower bound or deployable predictor. Closure is same-frame self-consistency, not multi-view truth or forgetting causality.

findings.issue: Empty closure set and empty 32-stride check grid are not handled. np.quantile(empty) or statistics.median([]) raises, instead of preserving count/excluded and NA. Aggregate closure means also cannot retain missing rows.
findings.minimal_counterexample: All self points are [0,0,0], or all world points are nonfinite. A valid full frame can still have no valid points on the sampled check grid.
findings.requested_change: Return count=0 and nullable summaries; scalar check verifies empty counts without taking a median; aggregate records complete and available denominators. Add artificial empty/all-invalid checks.

findings.issue: When GT is valid but no positive finite prediction exists, frame_oracle is omitted. Pooled oracle metrics then drop that frame and its GT pixels entirely; a usable frame can make pooled delta=1 despite another complete failure. Full-frame equality is NA, but pooled value is not clearly labeled incomplete and violates the stated retained-denominator intent.
findings.minimal_counterexample: Two one-pixel GT frames both depth 1: prediction 1 for first, 0 for second. First oracle delta=1, second oracle absent; pooled oracle delta becomes 1 over one pixel rather than a complete-set result.
findings.requested_change: Represent unavailable oracle explicitly and preserve intended frame/GT coverage. Either retain failure counts under a predeclared unavailable-oracle convention, or mark complete pooled oracle result NA and separately label available-frame metrics. Do not silently drop it.

findings.issue: Scalar closure check covers count, median and relative median but not reported p90.
findings.requested_change: Add independently implemented sorted linear quantile p90 check or narrow the declared scalar-check coverage.

findings.issue: prepare only tests preflight passed, not preflight script SHA, and omits hashes of S21 run_manifest and prior scoring metrics used for frame identities and scales.
findings.requested_change: Bind preflight script SHA and input metadata identities before sealing. The manifest embeds values, so this is provenance hardening, not an observed numerical error.

findings.issue: Initial RUNNING receipt says gt_png_read=false; after a partial GT read crash this stale state can remain even though bytes were accessed.
findings.requested_change: Record GT-read-start event before first access and cumulative/read-complete status without implying unaccessed bytes after interruption.
